qualification.rationale: Boise Remodeling Co. falls outside ForgeX's target market. ForgeX specifically serves owner-led home-service contractors in HVAC, plumbing, and electrical trades with approximately 10 to 75 staff who pay for leads. Boise Remodeling Co. is a residential design-build remodeling and general contracting company (kitchens, bathrooms, additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations) operating as a DBA of P5 Home Co LLC with a lean, subcontractor-centric operating model.
